displayName: Suspicious PHP Web Shell Script Dropped into Webroot

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified")
| where FolderPath has_any ("/var/www/", "/srv/www/", "\\inetpub\\wwwroot\\", "/usr/share/nginx/html/")
| where FileName endswith ".php" or FileName endswith ".phtml" or FileName endswith ".phar"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("php", "httpd", "apache2", "nginx", "w3wp.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Suspicious PHP Web Shell Script Dropped into Webroot
alertTemplate.description: Detects creation or modification of PHP or executable script files inside standard webroot directories by web server or PHP processes. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-21-php-critical-vulnerabilities.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Retrieve and analyse the newly written script file, verify whether it matches an approved deployment pipeline, and remove unauthorised web shells (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405; Advisories: acsc-2026-10-21-php-critical-vulnerabilities).
